_about: Your settings: copy this file to config/preferences.json, then replace every null and add at least one company (/setup can walk you through it). Lines that start with _ are notes and are ignored.

candidate._about: Who the resumes are for. Your name and contact line are printed at the top of every resume, exactly as you write them here.

search._about: What to look for. Add companies with node scripts/find-board.mjs, which turns the address of one of a company's job postings into the line to paste here; the other settings decide which roles are kept (docs/CUSTOMIZING.md explains each).

resume._about: How resumes are built. roles lists your past jobs, each as { "title": "Senior PM", "companyLine": "Larkfield (Chicago, IL) · 2020 – 2024", "minBullets": 2 }, banned lists wording to keep out, each as { "pattern": "a regular expression", "why": "the reason" }, and maxBullets caps the bullets under one role (null for no limit).

notifications._about: Where to hear about new resumes: everything is off until you turn it on. Text and email each need an address; the Numbers sheet needs none.

imessage._about: Text message through the Messages app. Turn it on and put your phone number in to; everyRun true also texts after every run that found nothing new (about 24 texts a day with the hourly schedule).

email._about: Email through the Mail app. Turn it on and put your email address in to.

numbers._about: Keeps a spreadsheet of every role in the Numbers app. It needs no address.

schedule._about: Whether the job pull runs by itself every hour: set hourly to true and run node scripts/install-schedule.mjs, or leave it off and run the pull yourself.

scout._about: Once a week, look for new companies worth watching (about $5 of Claude usage a run). day is a day of the week and hour is 0 to 23.

claude._about: Spending limits in US dollars: maxUsdPerStep caps each Claude step and maxUsdScout caps the weekly scout. A step stops once it reaches its limit.
